mu_name_from: OpenMU VersionSeasonSix/Items/Orbs.cs:58, CreateOrb(22, SkillNumber...) -- "Scroll of Summon". MuMain loads all five Dark Lord scrolls on one model, Data/Item/SkillScroll (ZzzOpenData.cpp:1061-1065).
why_this_one:
The only way the Dark Lord learns Summon (docs/plans/dark-lord-spells/summon.md). Group 12 number 30 is ours: MU's 22 is our Wings of Darkness (items.h kDarknessNumber). 23, 24 and 26 were kept free for the Dark Lord's scrolls (docs/plans/dark-lord-spells/fire-burst.md section 6).

Drops, and Tersia's fourth floor (The Red Floor) pays it to a Dark Lord's first clear (docs/plans/dark-lord.md section 6). No shop sells it, as in MU (the user, 2026-10-25: MU drops and the plan's quests).
mesh_note: No geometry of its own: MuMain loads all five Dark Lord scrolls from the one Data/Item/SkillScroll model (ZzzOpenData.cpp:1061-1065), so this names the one the pipeline builds, ScrollFireBurst.

stats.note: A Dark Lord scroll's row: OpenMU's CreateOrb shape -- 1 x 2, durability one, dropped by monsters.
stats.classes_from: The Dark Lord's alone (OpenMU's CreateOrb(..., DarkLord); the skill is his, sim::skillFor).
stats.requires_note: Level 98, MU's (the skill row's needLevel in sim/skills.cpp, and the skill block below). The energy is MU's raw 34 (OpenMU VersionSeasonSix/Items/Orbs.cs:58), which sim::asks scales as WebZen does, 20 + 34 x 98 x 4 / 100 = 153, the number the skill block asks.

skill.note: What the scroll teaches. Read once and gone.
skill.name: Summon
skill.tells: His party, wherever they stand on this map, brought to him seven seconds on -- unless they move.
skill.tells_from: The skill's own line in sim/skills.cpp, kept letter for letter.
skill.energy_from: MU's raw 34 through WebZen's skill formula (MagicDamage.cpp:663-677), 20 + 34 x 98 x 4 / 100 = 153; docs/plans/dark-lord-spells/summon.md.
skill.level_from: MU's 98, as on the skill's row (sim/skills.cpp needLevel).
skill.command_from: MU's Leadership 400 (OpenMU VersionSeasonSix/Items/Orbs.cs:58), asked whole at the read (Realm::useItem).
